scope: Actual current Twin motion lifecycle on dev and production. Normal contexts only add an independent passive MQL event witness; its callback never reads app state or another matches getter. Negative control alone modifies the served dev module by removing exactly two new frame reconciliation calls while keeping the live event listener and current renderer. Persistent capture and historical archive hashes are separate from current source/build input hashes; check-only never needs ignored scratch outputs. Production build outputs must be recreated by the normal frontend build on a new checkout. The inertia precondition uses sequential native-emulated CDP mouse inputs with declared20ms move/release timestamps and trusted passive event records; these are not OS gestures and do not inject application velocity. Actual camera glide, unclamped room, live preference change and exact stop are still required. No whole UI, visual, physical workflow, inventory or actual engine acceptance.
